## Reviewer checklist
Approving without checking these is a rubber-stamp and may receive no credit — check
every box honestly, don't just tick and approve.

- [ ] **Requirements alignment** — matches the linked requirement/acceptance criteria
      or PED section; doesn't silently edit baselined content.
- [ ] **Correctness & design** — logic is sound and consistent with existing structure.
- [ ] **Technical debt** — no unnecessary shortcuts; any deliberate debt is called out
      in a review comment.
- [ ] **Security & privacy** — no secrets/credentials committed; no obvious security or
      privacy issue introduced.
- [ ] **Tests / evidence** — relevant tests or evidence updated where applicable.
- [ ] **Documentation / traceability** — RTM, decision log, or related artefact updated
      if this change affects them.
